David Lim is not Scottish. He is originally from Weston Supermare and has lived in Manchester for the past 10 years or so. He is also a superb Luthier. I have a mandolin and bouzouki made by him, beautiful instruments. David plays uilleann pipes and is one of the organisers of the NW Pipers group.

↳ Posted by Kenny on November 22nd, 2019.

Re: The Edinburgh Rock

AilsaM, there was a period in the late 80s/ early 90s when Dave Lim was a regular visitor to Edinburgh. He made quite an impression at the Folk Festival sessions and a number of musicians from the north of England also came up at that time. His tunes were picked up by Edinburgh musicians, particularly those who went on to be part of Miro and Shooglenifty. Niall Kenny was one of them and The Trip to Pakistan was often played, so the pairing of Dave Lim and Niall Kenny tunes is a nod to that period.
